g.text: Missingness sensitivity: bounded extremes over all eight blocks
Original primary cohort only: 896 attempts; 890 valid graphs; 6 terminal failures.
Orange segments are identification bounds with missing endpoints allowed anywhere in [0, 1], NOT confidence intervals.
Black dots: complete-block means. A collapsed bound is not certainty. All differences use the same-seed US-English baseline.
